subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Which passive-capture producer and durable provenance/completeness contract should Birdclaw support as its first official third-party import surface?
rationale: The choice establishes a new supported file format, CLI surface, stored metadata contract, migration behavior, and future compatibility obligation that source inspection cannot settle safely.

options.title: Scrollmark v1 MVP
options.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially, while designing a narrow adapter boundary for later producers.

options.title: Multi-producer framework
options.body: Approve Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter together with a generic adapter contract, accepting a larger initial implementation and compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer capture imports
options.body: Keep official archives, live transports, and Birdclaw backups as the only supported ingestion sources until third-party formats mature further.

recommendation.title: Scrollmark v1 MVP
recommendation.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially, while designing a narrow adapter boundary for later producers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the repository’s product vision and the adjacent canonical archive and storage boundaries.
